description: This file defines Kubernetes API types related to device selection and taint rules, including DeviceSelector, CELDeviceSelector, DeviceTaint, DeviceTaintRule, and related structures for managing device taints and selection criteria.

methods.name: Expression
methods.description: A CEL expression used for device selection in CELDeviceSelector.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: The key of a device taint.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: The value of a device taint.

methods.name: Effect
methods.description: The effect of a device taint, such as None, NoSchedule, or NoExecute.
